Subject: Lanmore Fabrication - Quote Request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the submission on Lanmore Fabrication! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I'll work up a quote for the December 18, 2026 effective date and aim to have something back to you within the next few days. The $2.6M total insured value across the two locations seems straightforward, and I appreciate having the complete loss history.

I'll be in touch soon with our proposal. Let me know if anything changes in the meantime.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
